summary.prose: The work is a small, ordered change inside the analyzer planner: first the one band table is moved into its own module, then the task-count check and the prompt's range wording are built on it, then the correction message and the retry loop learn to state the count beside another failure, and last the planner gets its own attempt limit. Each step keeps the existing tests green and adds its own tests, and the live docs regression is run after the change is installed.

tasks.title: Move the band table into a leaf planner module
tasks.summary: Create a leaf module in src/analyze/planner that holds the band table and the focused lower bound and imports nothing from the validator or the renderer. Make validate.ts import it and keep SCOPE_BAND exported from validate.ts (re-export) so planner/index.ts, analyze/index.ts and validate.test.ts keep working. No value changes.
acceptanceChecks: SCOPE_BAND values and the halved focused lower bound are identical to today's, shown by the existing 'SCOPE_BAND values match the design doc' test passing unchanged
the leaf module has no import from validate.ts or render-catalog.ts
tsc build and the planner tests pass

tests.name: src/analyze/planner/__tests__/validate.test.ts: SCOPE_BAND values match the design doc
src/analyze/planner/__tests__/validate.test.ts: the band module imports nothing from the validator or the renderer

tasks.title: Expose the task-count check
tasks.summary: Add an exported function that returns the INV-13 PlanValidationFailure for a plan or null, using the leaf module's band and lower bound and the same message and target as today, and make validatePlan call it at its existing INV-13 position without changing any result.
acceptanceChecks: for every scope XS..XL, focused and not, at lo-1, lo, hi and hi+1, the function and validatePlan agree on INV-13 (message and target included)
validatePlan invariant order and results are unchanged for the existing validator tests

tests.name: src/analyze/planner/__tests__/validate.test.ts: the task-count check agrees with validatePlan at every band boundary
src/analyze/planner/__tests__/validate.test.ts: validatePlan keeps its invariant order and results for the existing cases

tasks.title: Print the enforced range in the depth policy
tasks.summary: Make renderDepthPolicy take its numbers from the leaf module, print the range once as the range that is enforced, remove the 'reduces the lower bound to half' wording, and delete the table copy in render-catalog.ts. Keep the scope-specific depth hints.
acceptanceChecks: for every scope and both focus values the printed range equals the INV-13 band
the output has no wording about halving
render-catalog.ts holds no band table
the existing renderDepthPolicy tests are updated and pass

tests.name: src/analyze/planner/__tests__/driver-unit.test.ts: renderDepthPolicy prints the INV-13 range for every scope and focus value, without halving wording
src/analyze/planner/__tests__/driver-unit.test.ts: no duplicate band table in the renderer

tasks.title: Let the correction turn state a second failure
tasks.summary: First capture the pre-change correction turn text for an INV-7 failure, with and without a prior failure, as a fixture, before the signature is changed. Then add the optional alsoFailing parameter to appendCorrectionTurn: after the primary failure and its hint, render the INV-13 failure and ask for both to be fixed. Without it the text is unchanged. The repetition banner keeps comparing the primary failure only.
acceptanceChecks: the pre-change fixture was captured before the signature change, and without alsoFailing the turn is byte-identical to it
with alsoFailing the primary comes first and the count second
a count that was a secondary note and then becomes the primary failure gets no repetition banner; a primary INV-13 repeated on the next attempt still does

tests.name: src/analyze/planner/__tests__/driver-unit.test.ts: appendCorrectionTurn without alsoFailing is byte-identical to the pre-change fixture
src/analyze/planner/__tests__/driver-unit.test.ts: appendCorrectionTurn with alsoFailing states the primary first and the count second
src/analyze/planner/__tests__/driver-unit.test.ts: repetition banner follows primary failures only, including the secondary-to-primary transition

tasks.title: Wire the secondary count note into the retry loop
tasks.summary: In runPlanner, when the first failure is not INV-13, run the count check on the same stamped plan and pass a non-null result to appendCorrectionTurn. failures[], the feedback files and the thrown error keep the primary failure only. Add the recording-stub-provider tests and, separately, the structuredStageForTest history and persistence tests from the LLD.
acceptanceChecks: recording-stub group: with a recording stub provider, the message sent on call 2 states INV-7 first and the count second; call 3 names INV-11 only, with no count section and no banner
hook group: through structuredStageForTest, failures[], feedback.json and the thrown error hold primary failures only
the INV-1 case states the count as well and keeps INV-1 primary

tests.name: src/analyze/planner/__tests__/driver-unit.test.ts: with a recording stub provider, the initial prompt carries the enforced range
src/analyze/planner/__tests__/driver-unit.test.ts: with a recording stub provider, the correction message sent on call 2 states INV-7 and then the count
src/analyze/planner/__tests__/driver-unit.test.ts: recording-stub replay (INV-7 plus count, INV-11, valid) accepted at call 3 with primary-only feedback
src/analyze/planner/__tests__/driver-unit.test.ts: through structuredStageForTest, failures and saved feedback hold primary failures only
src/analyze/planner/__tests__/driver-unit.test.ts: an empty task list states the count and keeps INV-1 primary

tasks.title: Give the planner loop its own attempt limit
tasks.summary: First search the planner and orchestrator tests for PlanBuilderExhausted, attempts.length and structuredOutputRetries assumptions. Then add a named constant of 5 in the planner and use it for the correction loop only; keep cfg.shaper.structuredOutputRetries as the wire-level maxAttempts given to completeStructured and for every other user. Update only the tests that follow from the new limit.
acceptanceChecks: the tests that assumed three attempts are listed and each is updated or left with a stated reason
a script valid only on the fifth reply is accepted on the fifth call
a script that never passes throws PlanBuilderExhausted with five primary failures after exactly five calls
every completeStructured call receives the shared structuredOutputRetries value as maxAttempts

tests.name: src/analyze/planner/__tests__/driver-unit.test.ts: five-call acceptance and exhaustion with the planner limit
src/analyze/planner/__tests__/driver-unit.test.ts: completeStructured receives the shared maxAttempts, not the planner limit

tasks.title: Final build and full sweep
tasks.summary: Run tsc and the planner and analyze test sweeps. The live docs-broad regression (INSRC_LIVE_TESTS=1, docs-broad-live.test.ts) needs the new code running in the daemon, so it is run after the push and daemon update, and its outcome is stated in the BUILD record as a reported live result, not a gate-run test. A failure after the count and the exact range were shown triggers the band revisit written in the LLD.
acceptanceChecks: tsc build passes and the planner and analyze tests pass, with unrelated pre-existing failures named separately
the live regression is recorded as a reported result with its outcome (final report reached, or the failing stage and invariant), or recorded as not yet run with the reason

tests.name: src/analyze/orchestrator/__tests__/docs-broad-live.test.ts: the broad docs request runs to a final report
